# TensorFlow Lite 2.16.1 (Apache-2.0)

Unmodified from Maven Central `org.tensorflow:tensorflow-lite:2.16.1` (AAR sha1 de6bec83f05a8b68c43333ba30e2aa5a0c728048)
and `org.tensorflow:tensorflow-lite-api:2.16.1` (AAR sha1 12775e5f5b11df06890a178993bfab66fae222f7): the `classes.jar`
of each AAR, plus the arm64-v8a JNI library. Vendored (owner approved 2026-10-03) because the offline build has no Gradle.
Used only to run an object-detection model on surround-camera frames in memory, results drawn on screen only.
